text: With Ingot now leaving, I opt to turn my attention to Willow and Illydia who are still drinking and sitting by the bar.
Despite sitting right next to each other, their bodies face away from one another.
Honestly, that's a pretty normal sight.
Willow has a…so to speak…a reputation to her. And Illydia, as cautious as ever, wants to try and not damage her own by associating too much with Willow.
Since Willow seems to be currently occupied with flirting with the bartender, I might as well just talk with Illydia first.
I plop down on the seat right next to her by the bar.
Fursttryl: “Hi, Illydia.”
Illydia: “Oh, hi Fursttryl. How was that fall from earl-”
Fursttryl: “SHHHHH! Don’t bring it up.”
Illydia: “Oh, my bad. Well, um, how are you finding the funeral?”
Fursttryl: “The funeral? It’s….fine, I guess?”
Illydia: “No strong emotions on it? I mean…”
Illydia: “this is Caine too after all, he did more or less raise you, me and the rest of us. Is this not impacting you?”
Fursttryl: “Well…you know me. I don’t think death is all that bad, really.”
Fursttryl: “Honestly, to me, death is the ultimate love letter *whispers* to Mamu *whispers*.”
Fursttryl: “So, Caine’s funeral…doesn’t really bother me at all. And you?”
Illydia: “Honestly, I get how much you adore **them** but you should really be more careful with bringing them up in conversation while we’re here, what if someone overhears?”
Illydia: “But as for your answer, I suppose that is…very you.”
Illydia: “As for me, I mean…I wasn’t too close to Caine nor do I fear death, really.”
Illydia: “But…he was a big part in all of our lives, I would be lying if I said that him no longer being here doesn’t sadden me a bit.”

options.label: 1: He was a bigger part in Reid’s life than ours
2: How do you think Caine feels about dying
3: We’ll join him in a few years

text: Fursttryl: “He was a bigger part in Reid’s life than ours, really. His sweet, beloved, baby brother.”
Illydia: “Fursttryl…I know that none of us were the biggest fan of Reid and Caine’s favoritism towards him…”
Illydia: “but is right now, at Caine’s funeral, really the appropriate time to talk about that?”
Fursttryl: “...It’s not my fault that Caine’s most defining trait was how much he coddled that loser…”
Illydia: “I do agree that Caine was unfair but I do worry that you’re too harsh on both of them, especially Reid.”
Fursttryl: “I’m not.”
Fursttryl: “How do you think Caine feels about dying? Sad? Acceptance? Fear”
Illydia: “Caine? How he feels? Hmmm…never really thought about that.”
Illydia: “Caine always appeared so in control of everything so maybe, death isn’t a worry of his either. But…”
Illydia: “But…I can’t say I know for sure.”
Fursttryl: “Well no, Caine isn’t always in control of everything. I mean, have you seen the number of times he panicked over Reid doing something stupid?”
Fursttryl: “So I wouldn’t say for certain that death is just a common passing thought for Caine.”
Illydia: “That's true…”
Fursttryl: “I guess the only one who knows is Caine himself.”
Fursttryl: “We’ll join him in a few years, don’t worry! You’ll see him again then!”
Illydia: “...”
Illydia: “hahaha! I should’ve expected you would say something like that. Always saying what you truly think and feel.”
Illydia: “At least your lack of social skills always tell me you’re being sincere and honest.”
Fursttryl: “Lack of social skills?”
Illydia: “I mean it endearingly.”
Fursttryl: “Okay…?”
Suddenly, from Illydia’s pocket, her sending stone starts to alert her of a message from someone.
Illyida: “Oh, it’s Merryweather. She says she needs my help back in the library right now.”
Illyida: “Guess I’ll be heading off but I might come back since she says it’s something quick.”
Fursttryl: “Oh ok! Tell Merryweather that I said hi!”
Illydia: “Sure, I can do that.”
Fursttryl: “And ask her about the progress on the books I requested be ordered to the library too!”
Illydia: “Fine, I can do that too.”
I watch as Illydia rises from her barstool and turns her back to leave. But just before she even takes her first steps towards the exit, she quickly turns back to face me.
Illydia: “Before I go, about what I said earlier about being more careful with talking about **them**, I mean it.”

options.label: 1: You know how much I care about **them**
2: I promise I’ll be more careful

text: Fursttryl: “You know how much I care about **them**, Illydia.”
Fursttryl: “I would never do anything that would go against my beloved’s desires. And that includes our safety.”
Illydia: “That is true…you are…obsessively devoted to your “beloved” to put it lightly.”
Fursttryl: “I’ll have you know, nothing about my love for them is light.”
Illydia: “Yeah, you know what, maybe I was worried about nothing.”
Fursttryl: “Exactly, never doubt my unwavering love for my beloved!”
Fursttryl: “I promise I’ll be more careful. Really, I will.”
Illydia: “That’s good, I appreciate that a lot.”
Fursttryl: “No worries, I know how much you care about our safety, so I’ll listen to your advice.”
Illydia: “Thank you, Fursttryl.”
Fursttryl: “You worry too much, Illydia. Everything is fine, don’t get so paranoid.”
Illydia: “I think you don’t worry enough. You hardly ever look at the bigger picture, Fursttryl.”
Fursttryl: “What’s that supposed to mean?”
Illydia: “It means, despite your position, your view of things is quite narrow…”
Illydia: “narrow…I would go on but I don’t wish to cause a scene.”
Fursttryl: “...Fine. Even though it seems like you have much more you wish to say to me, let’s cut the conversation here.”
Illydia: “Enjoy the rest of the funeral and have a good evening, Fursttryl.”
